subject.title: Feishu (and non-Discord channels) should apply sanitizeAssistantVisibleText() on outbound text

question: Should the remaining sanitizer gap be resolved by landing the open per-channel `sanitizeText` PRs, or by replacing them with a shared outbound delivery default?
rationale: Both paths are plausible: per-channel hooks match the merged sibling pattern and limit blast radius, while a shared default could prevent future drift but changes the delivery contract for every channel.

options.title: Finish Per-Channel Hooks
options.body: Review and land the open channel-specific PRs, then use this issue as the umbrella until coverage is complete.

options.title: Replace With Shared Default
options.body: Pause overlapping channel PRs and design a central outbound sanitizer default with explicit tests for over-stripping and opt-out semantics if needed.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Close only the Feishu-specific portion as fixed and move each remaining channel to a narrower issue or PR-owned track.

recommendation.title: Finish Per-Channel Hooks
recommendation.body: Review and land the open channel-specific PRs, then use this issue as the umbrella until coverage is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared outbound delivery, bundled channel behavior, and sanitizer policy; vincentkoc has recent history in those paths and the release/current-main surface.
